subject: saving files and using regular r commands

messages.author: 51d910b969139ad5
messages.subject: saving files and using regular r commands
parts:
I'm trying to use files loaded in Deducer with regular R commands in
the command window. It doesn't recognize the current dataset. If I
save the dataset, it saves it as an 'robj' file and I can't seem to
load that. On help site said I could save the data file in a more
standard '.rdata' format but I can't see how to do that. I'm running
Deducer in Mac OS X 10.6.6. thanks

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: saving files and using regular r commands
parts:
George,

That feature was turned off on the Mac. I've added it back it in the
development version of Deducer, so you will be able to save in
different formats with the next CRAN release.

You can load .robj files with the dget function, or just select the
file in the open data dialog and the gui will do this for you.

Ian
